text:
Priya: FYI customer reported /v1/generate returned 400 + parsing error when using JSON mode. They say ids are coming back as strings sometimes and booleans are omitted vs null. Also seeing enum casing mismatch ("status": "ACTIVE" vs expected "active").
Alex: Can you paste the raw request + response the customer sent? Need a repro to triage.
Priya: Pasting the minimal repro from customer below (redacted):
Priya: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"...","json_mode":"strict","schema":{"id":"integer","active":"boolean","status":"string"}}'```
Priya: Customer response body (returned 200 sometimes, 400 other times):
Priya: ```{"id":"12345","active":null,"status":"ACTIVE"}```
Priya: They also attached a failure case where service returned invalid JSON (trailing comma) once.
Jordan: Two quick checks: 1) Are they using the same model version across calls? 2) Any auth errors or token rotation during their session?
Priya: They said model pinned to v1.2. No token rotation on their side. They did mention intermittent auth failures earlier today (401s) but manual retry usually worked.
Nate: I pulled oncall logs for their org id — saw a cluster of 502s around 15:12 UTC and latency spikes ~1.8s/req for that route. Runtime returned a fallback payload in one case (text fallback) which could explain schema mismatch.
Jordan: Fallback would produce unstructured text -> structured JSON postprocessing can mis-parse leading to quoted numbers or missing fields. Also if pipeline retries with different model variant (quantized vs full) tokenization differences can change output formatting.
Carlos: Heads up billing — we saw retries for that org -> ~3x token usage during incident window, customer will get charged unless we apply a credit.
Alex: Can you collect a full HAR or the exact pair of request/response for the 400 case and the 200 case? Also include the request headers (especially Authorization and x-rw-model-version).
Priya: Provided one request/response pair and logs to the support ticket (TKT-5248). Note: their Authorization header occasionally missing the "Bearer " prefix due to client bug.
Jordan: That missing prefix would cause auth 401s, not JSON type flips. But client-side header bug explains intermittent auth errors which trigger retries -> may surface fallback behavior.
Jordan: Proposed quick repro: 1) curl with exact headers (correct token vs malformed), 2) toggle json_mode strict/relaxed, 3) hit same pinned model v1.2 repeatedly.
Jordan: Workaround: set json_mode to "relaxed" or add a small post-processing step to coerce types (id -> int, status -> lowercase). Example patch: ```json
{"json_mode":"relaxed","postprocess":{"coerce": {"id":"int","status":"lowercase","active":"boolean_default_false"}}}
```
Priya: Customer asked for a fix on our side because they rely on strict mode. They're worried about missing booleans (null vs omitted).
Nate: I'll triage runtime traces — looking for any codepath that emits JSON fragments or falls back to text. If I find a correlated fallback invocation we can add a server-side normalization step for strict mode to reject inconsistent outputs earlier (and return 422 with structured error) instead of best-effort coercion.
Jordan: For short term: 1) tell customer to use relaxed mode + postprocess or 2) ensure client keeps Authorization header stable to avoid retries. Long term: I'll add a ticket to the runtime to hard-fail when strict schema validation fails and include improved logging for field-level mismatches.
Carlos: I'll flag billing team to hold charges for the spike pending investigation.
Priya: Customer updated ticket, provided a small sample set of 6 requests where 2 returned quoted ids and 1 omitted the boolean.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: runtime/strict-json-logging -> canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC (by jordan).
Alex: Thanks team — escalating to eng-runtime. Priya, please reply to customer with ETA: we'll follow up within 24h and offer a temporary credit if cost impact > $100. :thumbsup:
Priya: ack, will update TKT-5248 and push repro artifacts to the eng-runtime board.
Jordan: tagging followups: will attach a minimal unit test that asserts id is numeric, booleans present (not null unless allowed), and enum casing normalized to lower-case.
Nate: I'll attach relevant trace ids and the 502 window logs to the ticket.
Priya: Closing loop here for the channel — will move deeper discussion into eng-runtime thread.
